name: Live Tennis API quickstart
info:
Polls the Live Tennis API for live matches every 15 minutes and prints the flattened match list to the debug sidebar.

1. Double-click the `live matches` node and add your API key to the Live Tennis API configuration (free key, no card: https://livetennisapi.com/subscribe/free).
2. Deploy — the debug sidebar shows an array of matches with p1_name/p2_name, sets, games, points (strings!) and server.

The 15-minute interval (96 requests/day) stays inside the free tier's 100/day cap — barely, so don't add more polling nodes on a free key. Faster polling (e.g. every 2 minutes = 720/day) needs the Basic tier (1,000/day).
